title: 第349章 绝境第350章 被抓
slug: 穿越源卡大陆我自带融合卡牌
lines: “不准跑，给我回来！”
矮人的怒吼在空间内回荡，
他巨大的手掌在半空中胡乱拍打，掌心的劲风将那些幻象击得粉碎。
可他哪里知道，林奇四人早已借着幻象的掩护，飞出了火山洞口。
“好家伙，还真是在火山内部。”
林奇回头望去，身后正是一座漆黑的火山。
山口冒着滚滚黑烟，连远处的天空都被染成了暗红色，看得人心里发慌。
“给我回来！”
矮人的声音从火山内部传出。
紧接着，只听“轰隆”一声巨响，他巨大的身形纵身一跃，直接跳出了火山口，稳稳落在地面上，大地都跟着震颤了一下。
他目光如炬，锁定了林奇四人的身影，迈开大步，在后面穷追不舍。
每一步都震得地面开裂，速度竟丝毫不比空中的卡兽慢。
“快跑，他追上来了！”
杰克脸色发白，拼命催动皇家狮鹫加快速度。
安琪拉也紧随其后，驱动白麟奋力向前。
“林奇，前面有个好大的村子啊！”
就在众人奋力逃窜时，梅比斯突然指着前方，一脸震惊地大喊。
众人抬头看去，一座巨大的村落赫然出现在视野中。
眼前的村落，比之前的哥布林村庄大了不止十倍。
一栋栋漆黑的石屋排列着，每一栋都高大厚重，比哥布林首领的石屋还要大上好几倍，。
“我的天，该不会有一整座矮人村吧？”
林奇震惊了。
一个矮人都这么强了，若是一村子的矮人，那他们还玩个毛啊？想跑都跑不了。
“有东西过来了！”
杰克突然大声提醒道。
话音刚落，
只听“轰隆”一声巨响。
地面突然炸裂开来，数条十几米长的灰烬蠕虫破土而出。
它们漆黑的身躯上裹着滚烫的岩浆，周身散发着刺鼻的硫磺味，血盆大口中布满了锋利的獠牙，看着就让人不寒而栗。
“嘎嘎嘎~”
与此同时，天空中响起刺耳的尖啸，大群寒焰鬼鸦扇动着冰冷的翅膀俯冲而下，羽毛所过之处，连空气都泛起一层白霜。
“糟糕，这又是什么鬼东西？”
林奇心中一沉。
突如其来的双重攻击让他们避无可避，空中的寒鸦、地面的蠕虫，前后夹击，根本没有突围的缝隙。
林奇来不及多想，立刻掏出骸骨之王卡和阿特拉斯之盾卡。
“全都向我靠近！聚集在一起，不要分散！”

content_en:
"Don't run away, come back here!"
The roar of the dwarf echoed in the space,
His huge palms flapped randomly in mid-air, and the strong wind from his palms shattered those illusions.
But little did he know that Lynch and the others had already flown out of the volcano cave under the cover of the illusion.
"Good guy, we are really inside the volcano."
Lin Qi looked back and saw a dark volcano behind him.
Black smoke billowed from the mountain pass, and even the sky in the distance was dyed dark red, making people feel panicked.
"Come back!"
The dwarf's voice came from within the volcano.
Immediately afterwards, there was a loud "rumbling" sound, and his huge body jumped directly out of the crater and landed firmly on the ground, causing the earth to tremble.
His eyes were as bright as a flash, and he locked onto the figures of Lin Qi and the others, took long strides, and chased after them.
Every step made the ground crack, and the speed was no slower than the card beast in the air.
"Run, he's catching up!"
Jack's face turned pale and he desperately urged the Royal Griffin to speed up.
Angela followed closely behind, driving Bai Lin forward.
"Lin Qi, there is a big village ahead!"
Just as everyone was trying to escape, Mavis suddenly pointed forward and shouted in shock.
Everyone looked up and saw a huge village suddenly appearing in their field of vision.
The village in front of me was more than ten times larger than the previous Goblin village.
Dark stone houses are lined up one after another, each one tall and heavy, several times larger than the Goblin leader's stone house.
"Oh my god, there's a whole village of dwarves, right?"
Lynch was shocked.
A dwarf is so strong, but if it is a village of dwarves, how can they still be fooling around? I can't even run away.
"Something is coming!"
Jack suddenly reminded loudly.
As soon as he finished speaking,
Just listen to a loud "bang".
The ground suddenly exploded, and several ash worms more than ten meters long broke out of the ground.
Their pitch-black bodies are covered in hot magma, and they exude a pungent smell of sulfur. Their bloody mouths are filled with sharp fangs, which makes people shudder just by looking at them.
"Quack quack~"
At the same time, a piercing scream sounded in the sky, and a large group of cold flame ghost crows flapped their icy wings and swooped down. Wherever the feathers passed, even the air was covered with a layer of white frost.
"Oops, what the hell is this?"
Lin Qi's heart sank.
The sudden double attack made it impossible for them to avoid it. The jackdaws in the air and the worms on the ground attacked from the front and back, leaving no gap for them to break through.
Lynch didn't have time to think too much and immediately took out the King of Bones card and the Shield of Atlas card.
"All come closer to me! Gather together, don't scatter!"
